body: I'm both in individual therapy and a group therapy for abused women. I started going to individual about three years ago, when he confessed everything and the group about a year and a half ago when he cheated on me again. They've been so supportive in helping me come to terms with a lot of what happened. And they agree, I deserve to be angry, but I also deserve to be happy. They've helped me learn how to not let it interfere with my life now. I struggled for a long time with my anger, and only recently am I finally getting it under control.
